projects.title: Chessentials - Stockfish Engine Chess App
projects.description: Chessentials is a Python-based chess application (Responsive) powered by Flask, Docker, and Gunicorn, deployed on Render. The app integrates the Stockfish engine for move suggestions and game analysis. I optimized performance using lazy loading and callbacks to ensure a smaller package size, and efficient user experience, even during resource-heavy computations. The app is designed to assist players of all levels.

projects.title: Data Structures and Algorithms (DSA) Guide.
projects.description: A Git repo is designed to guide people through the essential data structures and algorithms commonly encountered in coding questions. Structured into 14 chapters, each focusing on specific topics with detailed explanations, examples, and practice problems to build problem-solving skills.
